investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-08-10T00:34–00:42Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the eval pod because 2 nodes had insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource quota on the 2 nodes that carry that resource class. The remaining 4 nodes are excluded by the pod's node affinity/selector rules. With zero schedulable nodes and no preemption victims available, every remote-agent pod request is immediately stuck Unschedulable. This is a production infrastructure capacity or configuration constraint, not an eval runner bug. The eval failure is a direct and accurate reflection of the underlying scheduling failure.
